title: The Half-Light Postcards
author: I. M. Winterbourne
blurb: Dominic Pemberton, an heir cataloging a parent's silence after the funeral, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the last bus to the old neighborhood is rerouted forever.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
